bookkeeping.method: prior-date pitch-count pools (pitcher pools only when at least 25 PA) plus a shrunk hit-by-pitch rate by batter hand, pitcher and batter

pitch_sequences.method: real prior count paths by outcome (own pitcher with at least 12, else league by hand); pitch types from the pitcher's mix by hand and count, speeds from his distribution by type; league fallbacks

sample_selection: projected: favorite wins, nine innings, closest to the median of team runs, team hits and both starters' outs, strikeouts and pitches; then most central high-scoring, low-scoring and upset worlds
